page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance configured with 32 shared x86_64 vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 12.0 GB of RAM per core. The virtualized environment runs on the KVM hypervisor.

The hardware configuration features three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. This multi-GPU setup is designed for parallelized graphics, rendering, and machine learning workloads, though the instance does not include any local storage.

A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which makes the instance more cost-efficient compared to dedicated-core alternatives but may introduce performance variability under sustained CPU-bound loads. The server is suited for GPU-heavy workloads such as AI inference, data science jobs, and video transcoding where GPU processing dominates CPU requirements.
